messages:
ava: Quick design review — small batch of UX nits for the latency panel I sketched this morning. goal: make p95 + heatmap more readable at small widths and friendlier to keyboard/screen readers.
rui: Love it. Can you call out which controls change layout vs just copy tweaks?
ava: Sure — two layout changes: 1) compact micro-legend for < 480px that hides bucket labels, reveals on hover/focus. 2) timepicker pin toggle to keep a range synced across all dashboard cards. Copy/aria are separate.
jamal: micro-legend sounds good but worried about discoverability. Maybe add a tiny hint pill: "press ? for shortcuts" that expands to keyboard help.
morgan: For the timepicker pin, we also need a server-side flag — if a user pins a range we store it in the route state so reloads keep it pinned. ops concerns: pin shouldn't force other folks in shared views. make it per-user.
rui: Agreed per-user. UX question: does pinned range show a visual anchor? Ava?
ava: Proposal: a small filled pin icon at top-right of the card. tooltip: "Pinned time range — click to unpin". When pinned, add dashed outline to card and subtle baseline overlay on the chart.
lisa: Accessibility: pinned state must be announced to SR. Suggest aria-live region with "Time range pinned for this panel" and keyboard focusable unpin with aria-label="Unpin time range for panel". Also the pin toggle needs a 44px hit target on mobile.
ava: Good call. I'll add aria-live and bump hit target.
jamal: On the heatmap, consider adding a high-contrast hatch pattern for the top bucket when colorblind mode is on. That lets us avoid adding an extra legend column.
lisa: Yes — patterns + color pairs. Also ensure chart uses prefer-reduced-motion for scrubbing animations. If reduced-motion, jump instead of animate.
morgan: Backend: when reduced-motion is on we can return a flag in the user prefs endpoint so the client can disable smooth transitions. simple.
ava: Copy nits: current tooltip says "p95 latency" — propose change to "95th percentile latency (ms)". Shorter hover line: "95th pctl: 214 ms" for compact.
rui: +1 to explicit unit. Also change sampling label from "sample rate" to "data sample" — language from support team to reduce confusion with rate-limiting.
jamal: noted, but API param is still sample_rate. We'll map UI label -> API param in the client.
ava: Interaction idea: keyboard shortcut T opens timepicker, Shift+T toggles pin. We'll show shortcuts in the help overlay.
lisa: Shortcut suggestions fine; ensure they are configurable and disabled for inputs. Also bind a visible focus ring style to ephemeral elements so keyboard users see the scrubbing handle.
ava: Quick aria snippet for scrubber I propose:
```
role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="45" aria-label="Time range start"
```
use live updates: aria-live="polite" when the range changes.
lisa: That looks good. just avoid overly verbose aria-live messages. keep them short.
morgan: A11y + perf note: when many panels on a page we should debounce live updates to avoid spamming SR and CPU. 200ms debounce ok.
ava: UX microcopy change: legend header from "Latency" -> "Latency (ms)" and move percentile tags inline: "p50 · p95 · p99" instead of separate rows. saves vertical space.
rui: Could we add a baseline overlay toggle (compare to previous deploy)? small icon that overlays dashed line for selected metric. Product likes that.
jamal: We'll need a small API: ?compare=previous_deploy or timestamp. Backend ok to add endpoint returning baseline series.
ava: I'll update mock and hand off to jamal for behavior. also will add new a11y notes in the spec.
design-bot: Deployed design note: ava uploaded updated mock in Figma -> https://redwood.app/figma/latency-pin-baseline.
ava: Thanks — quick follow-up: labels for heatmap buckets, I want to abbreviate at narrow widths: "<50ms" -> "<50", and show unit in legend header. ok?
lisa: OK as long as unit is clearly visible and tooltip always includes unit.
morgan: Ops: small perf ask — default sampling should be 10% for heavy heatmap queries. we can make it auto-tune by cardinality later.
rui: good. Let's iterate on the mock and sync tomorrow 10am. Anyone opposed?
jamal: lgtm.
lisa: lgtm.
morgan: lgtm.
ava: awesome — will push updated spec and a11y checklist by EOD.
